paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in David in, "Judah gam a khua khatpeuh ah ka hohtou diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hohtou in," achi hi. David in, "Koi ah ahia ka hohtouh ding?" achi a, Ama'n, "Hebron ah,” achi hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa A David Bawl Ahi

paite: Huchi in David, azi nihte, Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail toh huai ah ahohtou hi.
David in akiang a om mi tengteng apitou a, michih a-inkuante chiat uh toh, Hebron khuate ah atengta uhi.
Judah gam a mite ahong hoh ua, huai ah Judah inkote tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi. Huchi in "Saul vui mite Jabesh-gilead mite ahi uh," chi in David ahilh uhi.
Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah David in mite asawl a, akiang uah, "Na pu uh Saul na hehpihdan uh hihlang a na vui ziak un, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen.
Tu in TOUPA'N na tung uah zahngaihna leh thutak langsak henla; hiai thil na hih ziak un ke'n leng na chit man uh ka hon thuk ding.
Huaiziak in tu in na khutte uh hong hat henla, hangsantak in om un. Na pu uh Saul asita hi. Judah inkote'n atung ua kumpipa ding in thau ahon nilh khinta uhi," chi in ava gensak hi.
Himahleh Ner tapa Abner, Saul sepaihte heutu in, Mahanaim ah Saul tapa Ishboshet apaipih hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa A Ishboshet Bawl Ahi

paite: Gilead, Ashur, Jezreel, Ephraim leh Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa in abawlta hi.
Saul tapa Ishboshet in Israel tung a vaihawm apat in kum sawmli a upa ahi a, kum nih sung vai ahawm hi. Himahleh Judah mite'n David azui uh.
David in Hebron a Judah chite tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi.
Ner tapa Abner leh Saul tapa Ishboshet sikhate Mahanaim a pan apawtkhia ua, Gibeon ah apai uhi.
heading: Israel Leh Judah Kidouna

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab leh David sikhate apaikhia ua, Gibeon dil ah akituak uhi. Pawl khat dil gal khat lam ah atu a, pawl khat pen dil gal langkhat ah atu hi.
Abner in Joab kiang ah, "Tangvalte hong kuan uhenla, i ma uah hong kisual uhen," achi hi. Joab in, "Hong kuan le uh ake," achi hi.
Huchi in akuan ua, azah chiang sep in agalkah phei ua, Benjamin chi, Saul tapa Ishboshet lam a pang sawm-le-nih, David sikha sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
Alangte uh lu chiat ah akimantuah ua, amau tumte chiat namsau in anak ah akidawt ua; apukkhawm vek uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Helkath-hazzurim achi ua, huai Gibeon a om ahi.
Huai ni a akisual uh athupi mahmah a, David sikhate ma ah Abner leh Israel mite zoh in a-om uhi,
Huai mun ah Zeruiah tapate thum, Joab, Abishai leh Asahel a-om uhi. Asahel zukpi bang a ngalhat ahi.
Asahel in Abner adelh a; Abner adelh taklam hiam veilam hiam a pialsan het lou in adelh vengveng hi.
Abner alehngat a, "Nang na hi maw, Asahel?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, “Ka hi,” achi hi.
Abner in akiang ah, "Na taklam hiam, na veilam hiam ah pialkhia inla, tangval khat man inla, agalvan laksak in," achi hi. Himahleh Asahel in amah adelh apialsan nuam tuan kei hi.
Abner in Asahel kiang ah, "Hon pialsan in. Bangziak a lei a hon satpuk ding ka hia? Na unaupa Joab mel ka mu ngam dia hia?" achi nawn hi.

Himahleh apial nuam tuan kei. Huaiziak in Abner in ateipi tolam in anakguh ngana nuaitak asun a, anunglam ah teipi apaisuak a, huai mun a puk in asita hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, Asahel puk a, asihna mun a hong pai teng huai mun ah akhawl zel uhi.
Himahleh, Joab leh Abishai in Abner adelhzui ua; Gibeon gamdai lampi a Giah chin a Ammah mual atun un ni atumta hi.
Benjamin suante Abner kiang ah akikaikhawm ua, pawl khat in akibawl ua, mualvum ah ava dinghta uh.

Abner in Joab asam a, "Namsau in hon negai den ding hia? Atawplam in ahong kha mahmah ding, chih na thei kei maw? Bang tan ahia a-unaute uh delh tawpsan a kik nawn dia mipite hilh lou a na om ding?" achi hi.
Joab in, "Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah na gen lou hi lechin zingchiang a pan mite paimang khinta ding ua, a-unaute uh delh lou ding hi ve un," achi hi.
Joab in pengkul amut a, mite adingh depdup uh. Israel mite adelhta kei ua, kuamah asual nawnta kei uhi.
Abner leh amite zankhua in phaizang tawnsuak a pai in Jordan akan ua, Bithron akantan ua, Mahanaim atung uhi.
Joab bel Abner delh akik nawnta a, mipi tengteng akaihkhawm vek leh David sikhate sawm-le-kua leh Asahel akimta kei uhi.
Himahleh David sikhate'n Benjamin mite leh Abner mite zathum-le-sawmguk athat uhi.
Asahel luang ala ua, Bethlehem a apa han ah avui uh. Joab leh amite zankhua in apai ua, khovak in Hebron atung uhi.
